identification: Bank of 21 Australian post office private box doors in a tall black-painted timber cabinet (about 1.2-1.4 m high, 3 doors wide). Cast bronze/brass doors with stippled ground and raised 'C A' (Commonwealth of Australia) either side of the lock, each with a brass number plate (sequence about 148-167). Layout: 18 small doors (3 x 6), 2 medium, 1 large at the base. Keys with brass tags in most but not all locks (several doors show no key). Heavy verdigris and worn black paint on the doors; cabinet worn. Probably PMG era, mid 20th century. Lot estimate A$400-600. The photos are identical to Armitage sale 28977 lot 1421 (11 Nov 2026, estimate A$650-850), so this is the same unit re-offered, not a sister lot.

Check the C A casting on all 21 doors, the back and sides of the cabinet for PMG or maker stamps, and whether the carcass is original or a later build to hold salvaged doors.
